title.narrative: Capacity strengthening for sustainable industrial development in Nigeria

description.narrative: As Nigeria is clearly accelerating its efforts on the way to industrialization with the launching of the Nigeria Industrial Revolution Plan (NIRP), UNIDO has been called in to assist the Federal Ministry of Industry, Trade and Investment (FMITI) to start building capacity in the FMITI to effectively lead the implementation of NIRP. The project focuses mainly on identifying and developing some fundamental skills needed by FMITI and a group of stakeholders for sup porting implementation of selected NIRP actions and in setting up monitoring mechanisms and a system of industrial performance indicators that will inform policy makers and other stakeholders on progress achieved as implementation proceeds.
